mechanism: Original-model relations for every literal observation; fixed support +1, conflict -1, neutral 0, original pool order breaks ties.
control: Same relation generations and native context, four cyclic orders for model final choice; same information, different decision policy, four extra model calls.
reuse: Existing six-order calibrated front and uncued four-candidate control; no new front calls. All40 exposed cases retained, regardless of gold coverage.
failure: Any invalid relation makes both arms return actual initial calibrated answer. Missing information does not produce negative evidence.
criterion: A bound-relation arm must improve over its coded-local counterpart and current calibrated head on both backbones before expansion; schema validity/order stability alone is not head success.
scope: Exposed development only, not independent generalization.
